mg_eryndor_ask_for_items_10.m: Oh, a human? A human, indeed. How surprising. Yes, surprising indeed, but useful. Yes, useful indeed.

mg_eryndor_ask_for_items_20.m: No, no, no. I ask the questions.

mg_eryndor_ask_for_items_25.m: The graveyard west of here, have you been there?

mg_eryndor_ask_for_items_30.m: Did you find anything on your way from there to here?

mg_eryndor_ask_for_items_pc_has_qs_thirt.m: Let me see what you found.
r: Yes, but I didn't keep them.
Yes, but I didn't keep both.
Yes, but I didn't keep both.
Why should I give them to you when I think I need them?

mg_eryndor_ask_for_items_pc_has_qs_thirt.m: Bring both of them to me.
r: Is there anything else I should know?

mg_eryndor_ask_for_items_pc_missing_qs_t.m: Wait! Don't answer that. I can already tell from the expression on your face that you have not found all that I desire.
There are two items that I desire located somewhere between here and the graveyard. Find them and return them to me.
r: Is there anything else I should know?

mg_eryndor_currently65.m: What are you waiting for? Go get my ring back from Vaelric.

mg_eryndor_give_items_10.m: Yes, you need to give me my things or we are not friends.
r: Umm, I guess so. Here. [You hand over the broken bell and the mysterious music box.]

mg_eryndor_give_items_20.m: I have a story to tell only to "friends". So being my "friend" means giving me those two items you found.

mg_eryndor_give_ring_10.m: So, you return with my ring?
r: Yes, here it is. [Hand it over]
Yes, here it is. [Take it off and hand it over.]
I already gave it to you.
I have it, but I've decided to keep it for myself.
I'm wearing it, and you can't have it.
Yes, but I forgot to bring it with me. I will have to come back later.

mg_eryndor_give_ring_100.m: He lifts his gaze to you, his expression unreadable, yet calm.

mg_eryndor_give_ring_110.m:
I have been bound to this world by resentment, by the belief that my suffering was without meaning. But now, with my ring returned, I feel... lighter. It's time to let go.

[With a final, grateful nod, Eryndor begins to fade, his form unraveling like mist in the wind. A whisper lingers in the air before vanishing entirely.]

mg_eryndor_give_ring_20.m: Eryndor's ghost reaches out, his translucent fingers trembling as they hover over the ring in your hand.

mg_eryndor_give_ring_30.m: You... you actually found it? After all this time?

mg_eryndor_give_ring_40.m: His voice is softer now, no longer laced with bitterness. He takes the ring, though it merely passes through his spectral palm. For a long moment, he stares at it, lost in thought.

mg_eryndor_give_ring_50.m: When I came to that swamp, I still had my bell, my music box, and this. But this ring was the only thing of real worth. The only thing I had left to bargain with when my body failed me.

mg_eryndor_give_ring_60.m: He exhales a slow, weightless sigh, the glow of his form dimming slightly.

mg_eryndor_give_ring_70.m: Vaelric took it as payment, believing he had done all he could for me. And I hated him for it. Hated him for leaving me in the dark, for shoveling earth over me when I still had breath in my lungs.

mg_eryndor_give_ring_80.m: He clenches his fist, as if testing the solidity of his fading presence.

mg_eryndor_give_ring_90.m: But now... now I see things clearer than I did in life. He was wrong, but not cruel. He truly thought I was beyond saving. And perhaps, in a way, I was.

mg_eryndor_give_stolen_ring_10.m: So, you return with my ring?
r: Yes, here it is. [Hand it over]
Yes, here it is. [Take it off and hand it over.]

mg_eryndor_give_stolen_ring_20.m: Eryndor's ghost flickers with anticipation as you hold out the ring. His spectral fingers pass through it at first, but he quickly pulls back, composing himself.

mg_eryndor_give_stolen_ring_30.m: You really did it? You took it from him? Hah... good. Maybe now he will understand what it is to have something stolen away.

mg_eryndor_give_stolen_ring_40.m: He stares at the ring for a long moment, the glow of his form pulsing unevenly.

mg_eryndor_give_stolen_ring_50.m:
This was mine. My last possession, my last choice. He had no right to claim it when my body still had breath. And now? Now it is back in the hands it belongs in.

[Turning the ring in his hand, lost in thought.]

mg_eryndor_give_stolen_ring_60.m: But don't think this is over. No... he will still know my presence. He will still feel my breath in the dark. This was never just about the ring. It was about what he did. About what he took from me that I can never get back.

mg_eryndor_keep_ring_10.m: You dare? That ring is mine by right! It was stolen from me in death, just as my life was stolen before its time. I will not suffer another thief to profit from my misery.

mg_eryndor_keep_ring_20.m: Eryndor's spectral form flickers violently, the air around him growing thick with a bitter chill.

mg_eryndor_keep_ring_30.m: You may hold it now, but I promise you, it will not remain in your grasp for long. I will tear it from your fingers, along with the flesh that clings to it!
r: I just hope I don't die for this.

mg_eryndor_music_box_10.m: There was one rival who stood above the rest. A relic hunter like myself, relentless and cunning. Her name is Celdar. We crossed paths often, always chasing the same artifacts, always trying to outmaneuver one another. And when it came to one particular prize, I won. The music box. It was something she sought desperately, something she believed should have been hers. I held onto it, not just for its rarity, but because I had bested her.

mg_eryndor_music_box_20.m: Eryndor looks down at the music box, his expression unreadable.

mg_eryndor_music_box_30.m: But now? What does a dead man need with a relic? It is time to put an old contest to rest. I want you to find Celdar and give this to her. Not as a gesture of kindness, but because it is right.
r: "Celdar", you say? I think I met her.

mg_eryndor_music_box_40.m:
Celdar is from Sullengard. If you don't recall speaking with her, that would be the place to start. But I suspect you have met her before. She is not one easily forgotten. She does not tolerate fools, nor those who waste her time with petty sales or empty words. Always clad in that garish purple dress of hers, standing out as if daring the world to challenge her. And she has never taken a loss lightly.

[He holds out the music box, waiting for you to take it.]

mg_eryndor_music_box_default_10.m: Have you brought the music box to Celdar yet?

mg_eryndor_music_box_default_15.m: What are you waiting for? Get going!

mg_eryndor_restless.m: I feel restless here, I was a traveler when I was alive.

mg_eryndor_vaelric_10.m: I came to Vaelric in my hour of greatest need, bearing little but a token of my past. A ring of no great value to anyone but myself. I was desperate, suffering, and he agreed to help me for a price. Not gold, not silver, but my ring. I was too weak to refuse, too lost to question his demand.

mg_eryndor_vaelric_20.m:
He worked his craft, took his payment, and let me rest. But I never awoke under his roof. I awoke beneath the earth, buried like a thing to be discarded. I clawed my way free, but the world had already moved on without me. My body failed, my breath faltered, and I perished alone.

And now, even in death, I remain. I am left with nothing while Vaelric hoards the last piece of my past. That ring was mine, and it was never his to take.

mg_eryndor_vaelric_30.m: Return my ring, and this torment ends for both of us. Vaelric can go on with his life, and I will trouble him no more. That is my offer.
r: You have been wronged, and I will not let that stand. I will get your ring back, one way or another.
If what you say is true, then this should not be settled with more deceit. I will speak to Vaelric. Maybe there is a way to resolve this fairly.

mg_eryndor_vaelric_help_both_10.m: Fair? What was fair about what he did to me? Do you think words will undo my suffering? I have lingered here too long for empty promises. But... if you truly mean to help, then do not return with excuses. Only with my ring.
r: I will come back with answers.

mg_eryndor_vaelric_jump_to30.m: We were in the middle of my story...

mg_eryndor_vaelric_side_with_eryndor_10.m: Then you see the truth. Vaelric took from me when I had nothing, and now he clings to what is not his. I will be waiting, but not always here in this spot. I will not forget this, friend.

mg_eyndor_give_stolen_ring_70.m: His expression shifts, something unreadable in his flickering gaze. A strange hesitation. He looks away for a moment before turning back to you.

mg_eyndor_give_stolen_ring_80.m: You have done me a service, and for that, I am grateful. But there is something else I need from you. Something unfinished. A debt of my own that I must see repaid.
